text: dsh-workspace-default-dir 是面向 DSH web 客户端的插件，用来改变「添加工作区」目录选择器的默认打开位置。它在 DSH 启动时为 native 和 browse 两种选择器后端应用补丁，并在设置页提供工作区默认目录卡片，通过本地 API 读取和保存路径。用户可以查看当前路径、设置一个存在的绝对目录，或清除设置恢复默认位置；也可以使用命令行查看、设置、清除和重新应用补丁。适合经常从固定项目目录创建工作区的 DSH 用户。保存路径会写入用户目录下的配置 sidecar；Windows 上还会保存用户级环境变量。

dsh-workspace-default-dir sets the starting folder for DSH web's workspace picker. It patches native and browse backends and adds a settings card and CLI to view, set, or clear the path. Choose an existing absolute directory; it is saved locally and, on Windows, as a user environment variable.
我想让添加工作区时默认打开某个项目文件夹。
能不能把 DSH 目录选择器的起始位置改成我指定的路径？
想从设置页面保存工作区文件夹的默认位置。
DSH 每次选工作区都回到用户主目录，怎么改成别的目录？
Make the workspace folder picker open at my preferred project directory.
How can I change the starting folder when adding a DSH workspace?
dsh-workspace-default-dir 的功能「设置默认起始目录」：为工作区目录选择器指定默认文件夹。启动时补丁让 native 和 browse 后端读取该路径；可通过设置卡片或 CLI 设置、清除。
dsh-workspace-default-dir 的功能「GUI 路径设置」：设置页显示当前目录，并提供路径输入、保存和清除操作。保存请求发送到插件本地注册的 API，路径须为存在的绝对目录。
dsh-workspace-default-dir 的功能「终端管理默认目录」：命令行支持 set、get、clear、patch 和 status，可设置目录、查询当前值、清除设置或查看并重新应用选择器补丁。
dsh-workspace-default-dir 的功能「启动时修复选择器补丁」：插件启动时发现已安装的 native 与 browse 选择器文件，并尝试应用幂等补丁，让两种后端都采用指定初始目录。
dsh-workspace-default-dir 使用前须知：该插件会改写 DSH 安装目录中的两个目录选择器模块；browse 后端在启动时加载补丁，升级或安装后需重启 dsh web 才能加载。
希望新建 DSH 工作区时直接从常用代码目录开始浏览。
Start browsing from my usual code folder when I create a workspace.

Make dsh's workspace directory picker (`Add workspace → Select workspace directory`) open at a directory **you** choose — for example `E:\python_project` — instead of the Windows user home.

dsh-workspace-default-dir README · Install：Pick one of the three ways below, then restart `dsh web`:

```powershell
dsh-workspace-default-dir README · 1) npm package (when published to npm)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-workspace-default-dir
dsh-workspace-default-dir README · 2) GitHub repository (ships the prebuilt lib/, no local build required)：dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/dragan2023/dsh-workspace-default-dir
section: 2) GitHub repository (ships the prebuilt lib/, no local build required)

text:
dsh-workspace-default-dir README · 3) Local directory (development / self-hosted)：dsh plugin --profile web add D:\path\to\dsh-workspace-default-dir
```

After restarting `dsh web`, a **Workspace default directory** entry appears under **Settings**.

dsh-workspace-default-dir README · Usage：Open **Settings → Workspace default directory** (`设置 → 工作区默认目录`). Type an absolute path — for example `E:\python_project` — then click **Save** (`保存`). The next time you open the `Add workspace` directory picker it starts at that folder — no restart needed.

The card always shows the currently active directory (`当前生效`). Leave the input empty and save, or click **Clear** (`清除`), to return to the default (the user home).

dsh-workspace-default-dir README · Usage：The same setting is available on the command line:
```bash
dsh-workspace-default-dir set E:\python_project   # set the default directory
dsh-workspace-default-dir get                     # show the current default
dsh-workspace-default-dir clear                   # clear it (back to home)
dsh-workspace-default-dir status                  # patch & setting state

The GUI card and the CLI write the same `DSH_PICKER_INITIAL_DIR` (`setx`-persisted), so they stay in sync.

dsh-workspace-default-dir README · Behavior & limitations：- **Both picker backends are covered**: the native Windows dialog (via `IFileDialog::SetFolder`) and the browse picker (used when the web server binds a non-loopback host, e.g. LAN `0.0.0.0`).
- **Registry fallback**: the patched pickers read `DSH_PICKER_INITIAL_DIR` from the process environment first, then straight from `HKCU\Environment` — bypassing the stale-Explorer-environment problem (no Explorer restart needed after `setx`).
- **Self-healing**: on every dsh boot the plugin idempotently re-applies the two small backend patches, so a dsh upgrade that restored the stock files is repaired automatically.
- This is a **patch-type** plugin: it modifies the two picker package files inside the dsh installation (idempotent, additive only). The browse backend loads its patched module at dsh startup, so one `dsh web` restart is needed after install/upgrade; the native dialog reads its worker on every open.
- Verified on Windows + dsh 0.1.0-rc.6. On other platforms/versions, if the edit pairs do not match, a warning is logged and the patch is skipped (dsh still boots).
